name: space-relics-3d
description: Space Relics 3D — file-backed interactive Solar System explorer (no database, no auth)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.render:build: npm --prefix server install --omit=dev && npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.verify:all: npm --prefix server run verify && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix client run smoke
